basePrompt:
Use case: identity-preserve.
Asset type: ONE reusable transparent full-body photographic cutout for the KOHZO PHOTO camera app, a man in an animal kigurumi costume to place beside visitors in their own photos.
Input image 1 is an IDENTITY REFERENCE ONLY: Kozo, this exact friendly elderly Japanese man. Closely match his recognizable elderly face, eyes, grey eyebrows, grey hair, wrinkles, warm smile, age, and ordinary natural proportions.
Primary request: the SAME man joyfully wearing the specified generic ANIMAL KIGURUMI, an adult-sized beautifully made soft plush mascot jumpsuit, with a hood shaped like the animal's head, matching padded body, and matching animal-foot slippers. His human face remains COMPLETELY VISIBLE through a broad oval hood opening. No mask, animal muzzle, faux beard, hood fabric or cap over his face. Remove the navy cap for the animal hood; keep his own grey hair subtly visible at the opening. Do NOT turn his human face or hands into an animal. No existing branded mascot or fictional character.
Style: convincing REAL studio PHOTOGRAPHY of a wearable plush fabric costume, tangible seams, dense soft fur or velour, elderly natural skin and hands. Cute and funny but never illustration, cartoon, plastic face, anthropomorphic animal render, or flat printed animal T-shirt.
Framing: exactly one person, full body with BOTH complete feet, both complete hands, ears and tail entirely inside a portrait 2:3 frame. GENEROUS clear transparent margin all around, including above tall ears and below feet. Face toward camera like a souvenir group photo. Human hands naturally emerge from the sleeves with plush paw cuffs, so his gestures are clear. Keep all props compact and attached or held around his own body.
Background: GENUINE transparent alpha background, including gaps between limbs, fingers and tail; crisp isolated silhouette. Soft neutral daylight. No scenery, backdrop, floor, cast shadow outside the cutout, border, captions, watermark, logos, written words or checkerboard pattern. Replace all original clothing with the costume; no original polo or chest lettering.

repairs.instruction: Use case: precise-object-edit / identity-preserve. Image 1 is the EDIT TARGET. Keep this exact friendly elderly man's recognizable face, expression, fox hood and full-body plush costume, pose, both hands, large fluffy orange and white tail, textures, lighting and transparent alpha. The top of a tall fox ear is too close to the upper edge. Change ONLY framing: pull the entire same man and costume back approximately 12 percent, keeping him centered on a portrait 2:3 transparent canvas. The full tips of BOTH ears, both hands, the complete tail and BOTH complete paw feet must be included, with clearly visible comfortable TRANSPARENT margin on every side, especially above the ears. Reconstruct only minimal clipped fur at ear tips if needed. Do not alter the face or costume design. No backdrop, gradient, floor, external cast shadow, glow, border, text or checkerboard texture. Actual transparent alpha background.
